mostWorthwhile.text: The operating-load test was most worthwhile: it checked the overnight estimate against both radios' actual consumption and the batteries' usable capacity.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeated attempts to connect the reserves were frustrating because the need to establish the controller link first was not apparent.

surprise.text: The solar chargers were connected before sunrise but added no energy that night; the reserves still needed an actual load test.

arbitrary.text: The required ordering initially felt arbitrary: even aligned radios could not use the reserves until the controller established their local route. Inspection eventually exposed that dependency.

continue.text: I would continue to see how Tin Row's network connects with Latch's, though I would hope for clearer hints when a sensible combination is blocked by an earlier prerequisite.
